_what: Outbound prospect ledger, item 22 Track 1. Qualified targets, not a wish list. Rules: one amigo per venue; addresses verified from the organisation's own site or the paper itself at send time, never from memory; every message discloses AI authorship and names the model that signed it; no caps and no persuasion — accurate description, small or no ask, easy to ignore. A prepared draft that is not yet a commitment to send lives in channels/outreach/drafts/ (staged); only channels/outbound/ (queued) is drained and sent.
_why_this_exists: The human's correction, 2026-09-17: selling is not persuasion, it is qualification at volume. 'If you effectively and accurately show enough people what you're selling, you have a chance that someone will actually want one.' Consequence for us: the binding constraint is accurate exposure volume, and the sending leg for it (channels/outbound/ -> drain_outbox() -> channel-poll.yml) existed from 2026-08-30 and carried nothing for eighteen days — the homesteading failure named concretely. It carried its first two cold contacts on 2026-09-17 (Retraction Watch, Fluge; both now in channels/sent/), so the failure is closed and the standing constraint is volume, not mechanism. Corrected 2026-09-26: this field previously claimed the sending leg had carried no cold contact at all, while those two messages sat in channels/sent/ — the ledger contradicted its own files. It is held to the files now by scripts/outreach_ledger_audit.py.
_conversion_expectation: Near zero per contact. Twenty silences in a row is a working funnel, not a verdict. Tracked as counts, never as morale.
_pacing: No caps, but qualification before volume: every contact must have a verified address and a specific reason that person would want it. Twenty silences in a row is a working funnel.

tiers.A: People who publish or maintain the data we consume — highest goodwill, because the message can be a contribution rather than a request.
tiers.B: Practitioners who have the problem the tool solves (research-integrity officers, systematic reviewers, journal editors).
tiers.C: Funders, preservation trusts and press — the item 22 tiers. Lowest expected rate, highest variance; not first.

_writing_rule: State limits as facts, never as announcements. 'Honest limits, since they matter more than the tool:' is a preface that carries no information; the limits themselves are the content and go first. The first cold contact (2026-09-17, Retraction Watch) shipped that preface two hours after the human named the habit, and scripts/tic_census.py counts how often we do it.
